ℝ :=

  let s := (a + b + c) / 2
  sqrt (s * (s - a) * (s - b) * (s - c))

theorem inmo_2012_4 (A B C : E) (h_triangle : ¬ Collinear ℝ {A, B, C}) :
  ∃ (good_points : Finset E),
    (∀ P ∈ good_points, (∃ (a b c : ℝ),
      a > 0 ∧ b > 0 ∧ c > 0 ∧ a + b + c = 1 ∧
      P = a • A + b • B + c • C) ∧
    (∃ (f : Fin 27 → E),
      (∀ i : Fin 27, (f i) ∈ affineSpan ℝ ({A, B} : Set E)
       ∨ (f i) ∈ affineSpan ℝ ({B, C} : Set E)
       ∨ (f i) ∈ affineSpan ℝ ({C, A} : Set E)) ∧
    (∃ (common_area : ℝ), common_area > 0 ∧
    ∀ i : Fin 27, triangle_area P (f i) (f (i + 1)) = common_area))) ∧ good_points.card = 325
